q: Evolution of E(B-V) over the redshift range 2.1 < z < 4.0 is limited to <2.5 mmag per unit redshift (1-sigma), consistent with the known, mild DLA metallicity evolution.
2015, Michael T. Murphy, Martin L. Bernet, “The dust content of damped Lyman-alpha systems in the Sloan Digital Sky Survey”, in arXiv:
